summary: Iteration 86 — First end-to-end frontend test of the NEW mobile (Expo/React Native) surface for TeamNest.ai against the shared FastAPI backend. Tested on the Expo web preview at mobile viewport (390x844). ALL 10 review-request flows PASSED: (1) Demo login via 'Try the live demo' -> lands on Chats tab with 4 chats. (2) Email/password login with amit@demo.team / Demo@2026 -> lands on Chats. (3) Redeem screen validates BOGUS999 as 'This code is invalid.' AND validates DEVOS100 -> green banner 'Dev OS Demo · 77 spots left' (full account creation NOT run to preserve seed uses; validation UI verified per spec). (4) Chats tab: 4 rows render with initials/avatars, previews (My AI Assistant / Marketing Site Refresh / Q2 Product Launch / Engineering), timestamps. (5) Chat conversation: opening My AI Assistant shows history bubbles + composer; plain text 'Hello from mobile QA test' appended immediately; '@ai What is 3+4?' returned an AI answer bubble showing '7' — real-time WebSocket at /api/ws/{chat_id}?token=<ws-token> streamed the answer. (6) Engineering chat '@devmanager <request>' returned a dev-manager agent response (the paywall/hire teaser bubble — expected business logic). (7) AI Research tab: 6 model chips render (chatgpt, claude, gemini, deepseek, perplexity, grok); defaults 3 preselected; Compare 3 models produced Synthesized answer card + PER-MODEL ANSWERS section (chatgpt/claude/gemini each rendered) in ~12s. (8) Tasks tab: 1 seed task 'Finalise pricing for Pro tier launch' loaded; added new task 'QA mobile test task <ts>' via input + '+' button (list grew from 1->2); tapping the circle checkbox removed it from the active list (PATCH status=completed). (9) You tab: shows name 'Amit', email 'amit@demo.team', workspace, role badge; Sign out returned to login screen. (10) Bottom tab navigation cycled through Chats/Research/Tasks/You cleanly. No red screen, no page errors, no broken images.

ui_bugs.issue: AI replies in the personal_ai chat render with sender label 'System' instead of 'AI Assistant' / 'AI Answer'. Reason: backend sets sender_id='ai-system' for personal-AI replies, and agentLabel() checks that first (chat/[id].tsx:28-33) before checking message_type==='ai_answer'. The actual answer arrives correctly ('7' for '3+4?'), so this is a cosmetic label mismatch, not a functional bug. Screenshot /tmp/05_ai_reply.png shows two 'System' bubbles: the echoed ai_question + the ai_answer.

issues: When @ai is used, the AI first echoes the user's question as a 'System' bubble (ai_question message_type) BEFORE the actual answer bubble. This double-render can be confusing for users because both bubbles are labeled 'System' identically — one is the question echo, one is the answer. Consider suppressing the ai_question echo on mobile since the user just typed it, OR distinguishing the label (e.g. 'Question' vs 'AI Answer').

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated prop warning in console: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Fires twice on every mount of the login screen. Reference: /app/mobile/app/(auth)/login.tsx:155 — change `pointerEvents="none"` to `style={[styles.bottomFade, { pointerEvents: 'none' }]}` (or wrap in a View with the style). Cosmetic in console only, not a functional bug.

action_items: LOW: Fix AI reply sender label in /app/mobile/app/chat/[id].tsx agentLabel() — reorder checks so message_type === 'ai_answer' returns 'AI Answer' (or the assistant's name) BEFORE the 'ai-system' -> 'System' fallback. Currently the personal-AI's answer always shows as 'System'.

LOW: Consider hiding or relabeling the ai_question echo bubble on mobile (chat/[id].tsx) — currently both the echoed question and the answer render as 'System' bubbles in the personal_ai chat, which is confusing.
LOW: Replace `pointerEvents="none"` with `style.pointerEvents` on the bottom LinearGradient in /app/mobile/app/(auth)/login.tsx:155 to silence the RN deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: mobile/src/api.ts: BASE = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — good, no default. Throws clear 'Request failed (status)' when detail is not a string. OK.
mobile/src/auth.tsx: token stored via expo-secure-store fallback (storage.ts). apiGet('/api/auth/me') refresh on cold start is correct; on failure it deletes token cleanly. OK.

mobile/app/chat/[id].tsx: WS URL is built via getBase().replace(/^http/,'ws') — this correctly produces wss:// for the https EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Token is fetched from /api/auth/ws-token per connection. Good. Cleanup on unmount closes ws.
mobile/app/chat/[id].tsx: setMessages upsert dedupes on id; ai_question echo + ai_answer both render — see design_issues above.
mobile/app/(tabs)/tasks.tsx: complete() does OPTIMISTIC removal from list, then PATCH; on failure calls load() to re-sync. Good UX pattern.

mobile/app/(tabs)/research.tsx: DEFAULT_MODELS = ['chatgpt','claude','gemini'] hard-coded — fine for MVP but note: if any of those keys are removed server-side, the preselect will silently drop them (filtered by `models.filter(core.includes)`). Not a bug.
mobile/app/(auth)/redeem.tsx: onBlur=validate is nice UX; auto-uppercase in setCode is good. The valid-banner correctly showed 'Dev OS Demo · 77 spots left' for DEVOS100.
mobile/app/(tabs)/index.tsx: previewText() strips markdown chars — sensible. chatTitle() has good fallbacks for direct/group/personal_ai. `linked_dev_project` gets a hammer icon.

All interactive elements have testIDs (login-*, demo-login-btn, chat-row-*, chat-composer-input, chat-send-btn, chat-back-btn, model-chip-*, research-*, task-*, logout-btn, redeem-*). Testability is excellent.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The mobile Expo web preview is at https://nest-app-prep.expo.preview.emergentagent.com (NOT the /api backend host). Use mobile viewport 390x844. All key testIDs verified working: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-btn, demo-login-btn, have-invite-code-link, chat-row-<id>, chat-composer-input, chat-send-btn, chat-back-btn, redeem-code-input, redeem-check-btn, redeem-code-valid, redeem-error, redeem-back-btn, redeem-name-input, redeem-email-input, redeem-password-input, redeem-submit-btn, model-chip-<key>, research-question-input, research-run-btn, research-error, task-title-input, task-add-btn, task-row-<id>, task-complete-<id>, logout-btn. Bottom tab labels are plain 'Chats'/'Research'/'Tasks'/'You' — use page.get_by_text(<label>, exact=True).first. WebSocket for chat is at wss://<backend>/api/ws/{chat_id}?token=<ws-token from /api/auth/ws-token>. AI @ai answer arrived in ~3-9s on personal_ai chat; @devmanager returned pay-gate teaser instantly (business logic, not a bug). AI Research /api/ai/research with 3 models returned in ~12s. Do NOT actually redeem DEVOS100 from mobile — it burns a seed use.
rca of the issue: Only cosmetic issues found on the new mobile surface. (1) AI-reply label 'System' vs 'AI Answer': agentLabel() in chat/[id].tsx:26-33 checks sender_id==='ai-system' BEFORE checking message_type==='ai_answer'. Since the personal AI's backend replies always carry sender_id='ai-system', the first branch always wins. Fix: reorder — check message_type/metadata.role_label first, fall back to 'System' last. (2) ai_question echo double-render: the backend inserts an ai_question message that visualizes the user's question as an assistant-side bubble; on mobile this reads as a duplicate 'System' bubble immediately before the actual answer. Consider filtering message_type==='ai_question' out of the mobile message list (they are already implied by the user's own text bubble). (3) LinearGradient pointerEvents deprecation: RN 0.74+ moved pointerEvents to style. Trivial edit in login.tsx:155.
